status: registered before training, CNF implementation and v3 performance runs
purpose: Need-feature ablation, stronger explicit CNF CEGIS, and actual fresh trials at each wall budget. No novelty/publication claims.
case_source: outputs/fairness-v2/cases.jsonl; test phase only, all 300 circuits; same known cases, explicitly a follow-up diagnostic rather than untouched final holdout
primary_population: 250 test circuits with n>=10; all remaining 50 shown as secondary small-size group
repeat_reason: Full Cartesian budget sweep on all circuits with nine methods, one actual independent timing trial per budget to keep CPU cost feasible. No reuse of a 10s trajectory as a 0.1/1s run. Timing-noise robustness beyond this is a limitation.
edit_domain: Exactly one non-noop LUT replacement OR earlier-source rewiring, exclude stuck gate, no added gates, no output rewiring; same legal_edits and mixed fault cases as v2.
specification: Full truth specification for acceptance/CEGIS. Eight sampled rows for all rankers; no full target or gold in ranker feature API. All accepted repairs independently audited outside timer.

training.learner: Exact original TinyForest implementation and class weighting, three seeded fits per variant, no search over architecture or parameters
training.labels: All valid one-edit repairs according to complete oracle, training only; validation used for selection only
training.no_need_implementation: Compute retained 13 ordinary local features directly; never compute backward need masks or any derived need errors, either for training input construction or timed deployment.
training.selection: For each variant independently: maximize validation circuits with any valid repair among top 16; tie-break smallest mean first-valid rank clipped at 65 (no repair=65); then smaller training RNG seed. No timing/test outcome used to choose seed.
training.matched_control: Train full21 with same data, 24-tree architecture and three RNG seeds, not only comparison against previously selected frozen model.
training.model_freeze: Weights, validation scores and feature lists hashed before starting any v3 timed test. Report all three validation results and test only selected variants plus original frozen model.

cnf_plan.solver: PySAT native incremental SAT solver if installable; choose a single available backend before performance testing, record name/version. No performance-based backend choice.
cnf_plan.encoding: Direct Boolean CNF; factor gate selector, edit-kind, wire slot, source selector and four LUT bits; exactly-one gate/source constraints; per-row gate truth constraints; incremental counterexample blocks; no candidate truth-table pre-enumeration.
cnf_plan.localization: Same sound disagreeing-output-cone gate restriction as Z3 allowed; no use of known UNSAT outcomes from previous runs.
cnf_plan.initial_rows: The same 8 sampled rows; full checker returns counterexamples; no full-table row constraints preloaded.
cnf_plan.correctness: Before timed test, compare SAT/UNSAT and legal decoded repairs with exhaustive edit enumeration on separate tiny seeds; independently check truth values and no-need feature equality with full-feature slice.
cnf_plan.deadline: Encoding construction inside same method deadline; cooperative Python checks plus native solver interrupt for solve time; timed-out/unknown is failure, never UNSAT.
cnf_plan.logs: Separate encoding construction, SAT solving and full verification times; clause/variable counts, counterexamples, verifier checks, solve calls, last phase and censored state retained even on timeout where available.

timing: Serial steady-state methods. Imports/loading/compiling learned models and common bit patterns excluded for all, costs separately logged. Candidate generation, direct feature extraction, ranking, encoding, solving and full checking included. Buffer telemetry until after timer. Any elapsed>budget fails. Parent watchdog budget+0.25s; hardkill fails.
order: For each case, independently shuffle budgets and methods using seed-based deterministic RNG; no method or budget always goes first. Case order also deterministically shuffled before run.

statistics.primary_ci: Two paired 97.5% percentile bootstrap intervals, Bonferroni family of two, 10000 replicates, circuit resampling, positive lower bound is evidence in that endpoint only.
statistics.secondary: All success-vs-budget curves, actual and failure-penalized time, per-size/fault results, mean/median/p90/p95 full-check counts among successes and matched-common successes, with timeout censoring explicit. Secondary CIs 95% descriptive.
statistics.penalty: Failure uses full budget; runtime advantage does not override a lower success rate. Actual times always retained.
statistics.unsat: Report all-circuit denominator as primary. Secondary exclude only unique cases reported UNSAT by validated CNF/Z3 within one-edit encoding; separate unknown cases and observed-solved union. Do not exclude every permanent fault. No published formal proof certificate claimed unless produced.
statistics.known_test_warning: All v2 test outcomes were previously observed. No v3 test tuning; final publication evaluation still needs untouched public/family-held-out benchmarks.

out_of_scope: MLP is not requested in this round and not required by journal name
No optimization based on v3 test outcomes
implementation_freeze: New training and CNF source hashes captured in a separate append-only freeze file before their respective training/performance phases. Fixes allowed only for correctness before timing, with records; this protocol itself is never rewritten.
